entities.name: Malil
entities.description: A golem made by Memnarch as his personal assistant, scout and enforcer, who mutated after drinking serum.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Corrupted ruler of Mirrodin who made Malil.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: Goblin whom Malil helped capture and torture.

entities.name: Darksteel Eye
entities.description: Item letting Memnarch see through Malil's eyes.

entities.name: green lacuna
entities.description: Site where Malil fought Glissa and was later killed.

events.summary: Memnarch forged Malil in his original likeness as scout and enforcer.
events.quote: Malil was forged by Memnarch during the later stages of his rule over Mirrodin

events.summary: Malil led an army of levelers against Glissa in the Razor Fields.
events.quote: Malil led an assault against Glissa in the Razor Fields

events.summary: Malil survived Glissa's attack at the green lacuna and helped capture and torture Slobad.
events.quote: assisted in capturing and torturing Slobad

events.summary: Malil tore the Miracore from Glissa mid-flight.
events.quote: Malil intercepted Glissa mid-flight and tore the Miracore from her

events.summary: Raksha and Glissa killed Malil in the final battle.

relations.quote: Malil was a golem made by Memnarch on Mirrodin
Glissa, rallying from her wounds, joined him in the final battle.
